name: Church of S. Domingo, Macao
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary: A view of the façade of S. Domingos Church, partly obscured by the houses on the left of the street. On the hill are the walls of Fort Monte, flying a Portuguese flag. In the street are cowherds, vendors and customers.

collection.museum: 维多利亚与艾尔伯特博物馆
